details.description: Palmyra Vision 7B is Writer's vision-language model, made available on Amazon Bedrock (model ID writer.palmyra-vision-7b) with a launch date of March 26, 2026. It takes text and image input and generates text output, with a 4,096-token context window and up to 4,096 output tokens. AWS's Bedrock model card describes it as built for extracting handwritten text, interpreting charts and graphs, image-based compliance checks, and generating product descriptions from images. Writer's own developer documentation separately lists a model called 'Palmyra Vision' (without the '7B' suffix) as deprecated, with a deprecation date of July 13, 2026 that has already passed; Writer's docs name no specific replacement for it, though Palmyra X5 and X6 now offer their own image-analysis capabilities. It could not be confirmed whether 'Palmyra Vision' is the same model offered on Bedrock, which AWS's own model card still lists as Active.
advantages: Built for extracting handwritten text, interpreting complex charts and graphs, image-based compliance checks, and generating product descriptions from images (AWS Bedrock model card).
Supports response streaming, guardrails and structured outputs via Bedrock's Invoke and Converse APIs (AWS Bedrock model card).
Supports client-side tool calling (AWS Bedrock model card).
disadvantages: Writer's own developer docs list a model called 'Palmyra Vision' as deprecated (deprecation date July 13, 2026, already past); unclear if this is the same model as Bedrock's still-Active 'Palmyra Vision 7B'.
4,096-token context window with no video or audio input support (AWS Bedrock model card).
No server-side tool calling (bedrock-mantle endpoint), and no knowledge base integration or Amazon Bedrock Agents support via the bedrock-runtime API (AWS Bedrock model card).
use_cases: Interpreting charts and graphs in images

sources.title: Palmyra Vision 7B model card - Amazon Bedrock User Guide

notes: Writer's own developer docs (dev.writer.com/home/models) list a model named 'Palmyra Vision' (no '7B' suffix) as deprecated, deprecation date July 13, 2026 (already past as of this research date), and point users to Palmyra X5/X6's built-in vision instead. AWS's Bedrock model card for writer.palmyra-vision-7b, launched March 26, 2026, shows 'Model lifecycle: Active' with 'EOL no sooner than Mar 26, 2027,' and AWS's model-lifecycle page states Bedrock's own lifecycle dates can differ from the dates a model provider publishes. It is not certain whether Writer's deprecated 'Palmyra Vision' and Bedrock's 'Palmyra Vision 7B' are the same model or a distinct, still-supported variant -- flagging for review. Writer's own product page at writer.com/llms/palmyra-vision/ no longer shows content about this model (it now serves Palmyra X6 content instead), consistent with deprecation on Writer's side, so no maker website_url could be confirmed; left website_url null. The 4,096-token context window and 4,096-token max output both match the catalog's facts exactly. Found no accuracy-style benchmark scores from Writer or a named leaderboard for this exact model.
